decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 6 - The maximum width of the crossover shall not exceed 2.4 metres. The existing garden wall and gate at the front boundary shall be retained, subject to compliance with Condition No. 5 of this permission.
Condition : 8 - The height of the extension along the boundary with No. 35 Grantham Road shall not exceed 2.0m high above ground level.
description: Erection of single storey side and rear extension to house, projection not exceeding 2.75m from rear wall of house, and provision of vehicular crossover
